periods.location: Hagun Academy first student dormitory room 405
periods.summary: Ikki returns from his morning run and finds Stella changing in what both later learn is their shared dorm room.
periods.cause: Kurono assigns the two surplus students, top-ranked Stella and bottom-ranked Ikki, to the same room under her meritocracy policy; Stella receives the key before Ikki knows.
periods.process: Ikki enters, sees Stella half-dressed, panics and tries to make things 'fair' by undressing himself, causing Stella to scream for help.
periods.outcome: Dorm security brings the matter to Kurono; the misunderstanding escalates into the roommate dispute.
periods.aftermath: Stella and Ikki's first impression is disastrous, setting up their duel and later relationship.
periods.significance: Introduces the main pair and the forced-roommate premise.
